title: Phage therapy intelligence
question: Who invents, funds and studies phage therapy, and where?
summary: Patents, research grants and literature mapped together to show how phage therapy is moving from the lab to the clinic.

title: Generative AI in science
question: How do researchers build, use, evaluate and debate generative AI?
summary: A large, screened corpus of generative-AI research, classified one facet at a time with LLM coding that is checked against hand-coded gold standards. Current work at CognosX.

title: The global preprint ecosystem
question: How big is the preprint world, and how can we count it reliably?
summary: Harvesters for Crossref, DataCite and OpenAlex, rules to identify preprint servers, and public explorers built on the resulting dataset.

title: Research equity in Africa
question: Who gets to publish, share and lead research in Africa?
summary: Continent-wide measures of open access, collaboration, leadership and gender in African research output.

title: Epidemics, surveillance and One Health
question: How well do research and surveillance data track outbreaks, from COVID-19 to malaria and ticks?
summary: Studies of epidemic research output, case reporting, under-reporting and surveillance, across human, animal and environmental health.

title: Biotech and innovation intelligence
question: Which companies, inventors and technologies lead a field, and where is it heading?
summary: Patent and publication intelligence for biotech teams and recruiters, delivered through CognosX as reports, dashboards and pipelines.

title: Microbes in health and disease
question: Which bacteria live in us, and how do they shape disease and treatment?
summary: Culturomics and taxonogenomics of the human microbiota, from new respiratory species to the gut bacteria that affect cancer immunotherapy.

title: Open-source toolbox
question: Reusable code behind the studies, free on GitHub.
summary: General-purpose tools for collecting, enriching, analysing and moving scholarly data.
